taskChanges.newValue: Implemented global RPC policy in rpcMessageForSettings plus execution-time interceptor enforcement. Experimental, Draft, quick refresh, reward claims, MQTT and resource/skin follow-ups now inherit popupRpcEnabled/socketRefreshMode. Piggyback needs Monitor API, bounded helper actions expire after two minutes, settings changes cancel queued calls, actions never automatically retry, and one game tab is targeted. Draft/claim companion refresh follows action order even with an earlier native read. Generic Unity commands cannot bypass Piggyback and are rejected there. Updated canonical docs and active preference memory xvorcs. 95 relevant tests pass; full suite 249/259, with remaining 10 failures caused by missing historical trace fixtures. Fixed outdated gather metadata assertion and popup test helper dependency. Syntax/CSS checks pass; npm build succeeds. System Decision Impact: candidate @decision/20261106-1121-all-helper-rpc-calls-inherit-shared-settings (added) — records the user's explicit global RPC inheritance rule, retained as draft per decision workflow.
